git add internal/radarr/types.go internal/radarr/client_test.go internal/sonarr/types.go internal/sonarr/client_test.go && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix: decode Sonarr/Radarr Release.Quality as nested object

The Sonarr and Radarr v3 /api/v3/release responses return `quality` as a
nested object containing a `quality` definition and a `revision`, not a
flat string. The string field caused every manual_search invocation to
fail to decode.

Replace `Quality string` on the Release struct in both clients with a
`Quality` struct (nesting `QualityDefinition` and `Revision`). Update the
ManualSearch tests to drive a fixture matching the real API shape so the
nested decoding is exercised end-to-end.
EOF
)"

## Summary
- Sonarr's and Radarr's `/api/v3/release` responses return `quality` as a nested object (`{quality: {id, name, …}, revision: {…}}`), but `Release.Quality` was typed as `string`. Every `manual_search` / `manual_movie_search` invocation failed with `cannot unmarshal object into Go struct field Release.quality of type string`.
- Introduce `Quality`, `QualityDefinition`, and `Revision` types in both `internal/radarr/types.go` and `internal/sonarr/types.go`, and switch `Release.Quality` to use the nested struct.
- Update each client's `TestManualSearch` to drive a raw-JSON fixture that mirrors the real API shape, so the nested decode is exercised end-to-end. Both tests fail against the prior `string` typing and pass with the new structs.

## Test plan
- [x] `go build ./...`
- [x] `go vet ./...`
- [x] `go test ./...`
- [x] `go test ./internal/radarr -run TestManualSearch -v`
- [x] `go test ./internal/sonarr -run TestManualSearch -v`

Closes #44

PR created: https://github.com/gunk-dev/reel-life/pull/48

Summary of changes:
- `internal/radarr/types.go` and `internal/sonarr/types.go`: Replaced `Release.Quality string` with a nested `Quality` struct containing `QualityDefinition` and `Revision`, matching the real Radarr/Sonarr v3 `/api/v3/release` response shape.
- `internal/radarr/client_test.go` and `internal/sonarr/client_test.go`: Rewrote `TestManualSearch` to serve a raw-JSON fixture from the issue and assert on `Quality.Quality.Name`, `Quality.Quality.Resolution`, and `Quality.Revision.Version`. These tests fail against the old string typing and pass against the new structs.
- No call sites assumed `Release.Quality` was a string, so no consumer-code updates were needed.
- `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...`, and `go test ./...` all green; `klaus _pre-review` returned no findings.
